messages:
maria: Heads-up: PR gating failing intermittently after I added the quantized-8bit matrix. GH check shows 'artifact missing' but Buildkite runner logs show upload succeeded. Any ideas?
ci-bot: [info] New PR checks queued: eval/quant-matrix, eval/smoke
ashish: Saw something similar yesterday. My hunch: runner reuse + tmp dir cleanup race or orchestration callback drops.
nina: Do we still reuse self-hosted GHA runners? I thought the heavy jobs were offloaded to Buildkite. Label is 'redwood-eval' though.
sam: Hybrid flow: GH Actions starts matrix; light smoke stays in GHA; heavy evals call Buildkite via webhook.
maria: Repro steps: push PR -> gha matrix kicks off -> some jobs call `bk run-eval --shard ${{ matrix.shard }}` -> bk uploads artifact to s3 -> gha job expects artifact annotated on check-run -> sometimes the annotation/URL isn't present even though BK log says upload ok.
kevin: Could be S3 eventual consistency but unlikely at our scale; more likely the annotation service (bk -> orchestrator -> GH) raced/timed out. Do we have logs from the orchestrator?
maria: Logs attached in the BK job: upload reported success, returned 200. GHA action waiting loop shows repeated 404 on s3 listing. Snippet of GHA wait step:
```
- name: Wait for eval artifact
  run: |
    for i in $(seq 1 20); do
      aws s3 ls s3://redwood-evals/${{ github.sha }}-quant-${{ matrix.variant }} && exit 0 || sleep 10
    done
    exit 1
```
ashish: That loop handles S3 eventual consistency but if annotation is generated by a separate callback, the check-run might be updated before our action polls or vice-versa. Also our orchestrator sometimes returns 202 when it's queued. Add retries + verify check-run metadata.
nina: Polling Buildkite for job completion + artifact URL would be better than S3 polling. BK signals artifact URL once job is 'passed'. Less noisy.
sam: Polling BK adds latency to PR checks. Can we gate on a lightweight smoke in GHA (fast) and make the heavy quant matrix blocking but allowed-to-fail? Product wants quant smoke to be gating for model onboarding though.
maria: Product insists quant smoke must gate merges for new model bring-ups. So making heavy jobs optional is not an option here. We need reliable orchestration.
kevin: Signed callback from BK to orchestrator that then posts to GH as the canonical source sounds good. The GH action can wait on a webhook signal or poll an internal endpoint.
ashish: We have `eval-orchestrator` that does BK callbacks -> annotates PRs. Current metrics show spikes of 429s from the GitHub app during peak times; looks rate-limited. If orchestrator drops the annotation, GHA waits forever and times out.
nina: 429s imply we should batch annotations or use exponential backoff + DLQ for failed updates. Also add idempotency keys so retries are safe.
sam: Runner reuse concern: self-hosted runners occasionally run two jobs too close together and artifact paths collide. Ensure uploader uses unique per-run paths: `run_id` + `matrix.variant` + `pr`.
maria: Current BK uploader uses `eval_name-${pr}`. I'll change it to include `github.run_id`.
ashish: Also add SHA checks: compute artifact SHA before upload, annotate check-run with `artifact-sha`. GHA can verify on download and fail early on mismatch.
ci-bot: [deploy-bot] Deployed eval-orchestrator v1.3.4 with exponential backoff + DLQ. Rolling to staging.
maria: I'll push a small GH Action change to poll Buildkite job status (and retry the annotation fetch) while we stabilize orchestrator. @ashish can you add the artifact-sha annotation in the BK uploader?
ashish: On it. Will prefix path with run_id and include `X-Eval-Artifact-SHA` header.
nina: Also propose adding a tiny in-repo smoke fixture (100 examples) that runs in <60s so gating is less brittle.
sam: Agreed. And let's add a Redwood Console dashboard panel for PR gating failures by failure-mode: upload, annotation, checksum, timeout. That should help triage recurring flakes.
maria: Thanks team — I'll open PR with the GH Action polling change + notes. :thumbsup:
kevin: P.S. for future postmortems: always record Buildkite job ids + GHA check-run ids together (and the orchestrator message id). Makes tracing so much easier.
